questions.question: What triggers the argument between Ewa and Wojtek?
answers: The decision that Wojtek can't go to a party
questions.explanation: Wojtek shuts himself in his room after Ewa forbids him from going to a party.

questions.question: What does Ewa read on her phone that moves her?
answers: Posts about supportive parenting of a teenager
questions.explanation: On the screen appears a post by a woman who calls herself a supportive mother of a teenager.

questions.question: Which sentence particularly stops Ewa?
answers: Children always listen to their parents
You don't have to be perfect. You have to be present
questions.explanation: She stops at the sentence: you don't have to be perfect, you have to be present.

questions.question: What is Ewa by training?
questions.explanation: The text says directly that Ewa was a psychologist by training.

questions.question: What does Ewa understand at the end of the story?
answers: That her son has stopped loving her
That what mattered most she learned from her son — about being present and authentic
That she should send her son to boarding school
questions.explanation: The final reflection says that what mattered most came from her son, who had been seeing her all along.
